purpose: Adversarial E05/E31 cases: a quote must not turn a substring inside a different amount, year, negated word, or unit into sourced evidence.

cases.reason: The quote truncates the source amount by one digit.
The quote is only a prefix of a different numeric token.
The quote starts inside a negated word and reverses its apparent meaning.
The quote truncates the case-sensitive source unit.
A comma between digits continues a numeric amount, rather than ending the quoted amount.
